facts.fact: The BCEAO approved InTouch as a payment institution in Burkina Faso, per Ecofin Agency.
The BCEAO approved SycaPay, Firstcom Global Payments, Julaya and InTouch as payment institutions in Cote d'Ivoire, per Ecofin Agency.
The BCEAO approved InTouch as a payment institution in Mali, per Ecofin Agency.
i-FUTURE announced on 19 May 2025 that it had received its BCEAO payment institution licence in Niger.
The BCEAO authorised five providers in Senegal: PayDunya and Bictorys as payment institutions, Mikaty and Flutterwave Senegal as payment service providers, and InTouch as an e-money institution.
